features.title: Pack Mixer
features.text: Take single textures from any pack in your folder, like anchors, crystals, totems, pearls and armour sets, and save them as one pack with a coloured name. Open it from Options, Resource Packs.

features.title: Pack previews
features.text: Hovering a pack shows anchors, glowstone and obsidian as whole blocks, and the incompatible version warnings are gone.
